subject: Re: IPDF status: decision - labeling-gate integration recommended
body:
All,

Closing out for the July 6 memo. The June sweep completed inside the reserved week (the 20% slack got used, for the record - Katya was right to defend it), and the numbers make the case: on the internal parts set, gating auto-labels on IPDF pose uncertainty cuts wrong-pose label acceptance by 71% on symmetric parts at a 9% throughput cost, versus the regressor-confidence gate.

Decision: the memo recommends IPDF as the pose-uncertainty gate for the labeling pipeline, phased in starting with part families where symmetry is documented. The dense-grid evaluation cost stays a batch-mode reality - the memo is explicit that this gate runs offline, not in any interactive path, until someone funds a distillation effort.

Santiago - the dry-run-before-reserved-week practice goes in the memo as a recommended pattern. Cheap insurance that saved us the week, twice.

Dmitri
